MEGAHORN.Name: Megahorn
MEGAHORN.Description: Throws the target with an impressive horn, but this lowers the user's Sp. Atk.

ATTACKORDER.Name: Attack Order
ATTACKORDER.Description: Sicks underlings onto the target. Gains/loses 10 power for each stat boost/reduction.

BUGBUZZ.Name: Bug Buzz
BUGBUZZ.Description: The user generates a damaging sound wave by vibration. Has a 20% chance to lower Sp. Def.

XSCISSOR.Name: X-Scissor
XSCISSOR.Description: Sawblades the target, cutting their last-used move's PP by 4, or 8 if it crits.

SIGNALBEAM.Name: Signal Beam
SIGNALBEAM.Description: The user attacks with a disorienting beam that suppresses the target's ability.

UTURN.Name: U-turn
UTURN.Description: The user attacks and relays back in one motion, switching out for another Pokémon.

CHITINCRUMPLER.Name: Chitin Crumpler
CHITINCRUMPLER.Description: This gnarling attack breaks protection, substitutes, screens, and side-wide effects.

MANDIBLEMUNCH.Name: Mandible Munch
MANDIBLEMUNCH.Description: A bite that consumes an opponent's Berry or healing item and gains that item's effect.

SILVERWIND.Name: Silver Wind
SILVERWIND.Description: Summons a mystical wind that damages enemies and always raises the user's Sp. Atk.

SKITTERSCATTER.Name: Skitter Scatter
SKITTERSCATTER.Description: Scatters annoying hairs to damage all enemies and always lower their Sp. Atk.

TWINEEDLE.Name: Twineedle
TWINEEDLE.Description: The user jabs twice with spikes. Each hit has a 20% Poison chance.

WRITHINGREND.Name: Writhing Rend
WRITHINGREND.Description: This thrashing, cutting attack has +35 power for each consecutive momentum move used.

LEECHLIFE.Name: Leech Life
LEECHLIFE.Description: The user drains the target's blood. Restores HP equal to 1/2 damage dealt.

PINCUSHION.Name: Pin Cushion
PINCUSHION.Description: Jabs with crippling pins 2-4 times. Each has a 10% Paralysis chance.

DEFENDORDER.Description: Calls out underlings to shield all allies' bodies, raising their Defense and Sp. Def.

HEALORDER.Name: Heal Order
HEALORDER.Description: The user calls out their underlings to heal them with priority, restoring 1/2 Max HP.

QUIVERDANCE.Name: Quiver Dance
QUIVERDANCE.Description: A beautiful, shimmering dance that raises Sp. Atk, Sp. Def, and Speed.

GARDENVARIETY.Name: Garden Variety
GARDENVARIETY.Description: Gives your team's next momentum, recharge, powder, biting, and healing move x1.5 dmg. Stacks 8x.

COLDBLOOD.Name: Cold Blood
COLDBLOOD.Description: A merciless, stone-cold assault. 50% chance to disable the target's moves' secondary effects.

SILKROAD.Name: Silk Road
SILKROAD.Description: Deals damage equal to user's level. Restores HP equal to 1/2 damage dealt if the user is itemless.

TAILGLOW.Name: Tail Glow
TAILGLOW.Description: The user empowers themselves with chemicals, drastically raising their Special Attack.

FOULPLAY.Name: Foul Play
FOULPLAY.Description: This cheap shot uses the target's Attack as your attacking stat.

PIERCETHEVEIL.Name: Pierce the Veil
PIERCETHEVEIL.Description: Conjures dark forces to attack. Has a 50% chance to sharply raise the user's Sp. Def.

CRUNCH.Name: Crunch
CRUNCH.Description: The user crunches up the target with sharp fangs that have a 20% chance to lower the target's Defense.

INNERDARKNESS.Name: Inner Darkness
INNERDARKNESS.Description: This pulse consumes a Phazard to randomly status its targets OR raise the user's Sp. Atk.

SUCKERPUNCH.Name: Sucker Punch
SUCKERPUNCH.Description: A cheap shot that strikes with priority, but fails if the target is not using a damaging move.

NIGHTFALL.Name: Nightfall
NIGHTFALL.Description: This blindsiding, knifelike attack has a 50% chance to steal 1 Crit Ratio from the target.

GNASHINGTEETH.Name: Gnashing Teeth
GNASHINGTEETH.Description: This remorseless affliction saps 1/8th Max HP each turn if the user has 3 moves or less.

SUBTERFUGE.Name: Subterfuge
SUBTERFUGE.Description: A deceptive attack. Deals x2 damage if the user is Compromised. Breaks protection; never misses.

SNARL.Name: Snarl
SNARL.Description: The user demoralizes and subdues opposing Pokémon, always lowering their Sp. Attack.

INSULTTOINJURY.Name: InsulttoInjury
INSULTTOINJURY.Description: If the target is Compromised, this demoralizing attack lowers all their stats 1 stage.

WAILINGWALLS.Name: Wailing Walls
WAILINGWALLS.Description: Deals x2 dmg against trapped targets or after trapping targets 3x this battle.

PURSUIT.Name: Pursuit
PURSUIT.Description: The power of this relentless attack is doubled if used on a target switching out of battle.

LARCENY.Name: Larceny
LARCENY.Description: This sneaky attack steals the target's item. Deals x2 dmg to itemless targets.

KNOCKOFF.Name: Knock Off
KNOCKOFF.Description: Knocks away the target's held item, but deals 1/2 dmg to itemless targets.

BEATUP.Name: Beat Up
BEATUP.Description: Deals damage for each of the user's party Pokémon. Damage is based on the party's base Atk stats.

FLING.Name: Fling
FLING.Description: The user flings a held item at the target to attack. This move's power and effects depend on the item.

PUNISHMENT.Name: Punishment
PUNISHMENT.Description: Punishes the target. Has +10 power for each of the target's stat changes.

DARKVOID.Name: Dark Void
DARKVOID.Description: Summons a rift that drags all Pokémon into total darkness. Has a 70% chance to induce Sleep.

EMBARGO.Name: Embargo
EMBARGO.Description: Prevents the entire opposing team from using their held items for 8 turns.

FAKETEARS.Name: Fake Tears
FAKETEARS.Description: The user feigns crying to fluster the targets, lowering their Sp. Atk and Sp. Def.

FLATTER.Name: Flatter
FLATTER.Description: Flattery is used to Confuse the target. This also lowers the target's Sp. Def stat.

HONECLAWS.Description: The user prepares to attack, slightly raising their Accuracy and sharply raising their Attack.

BAGOFTRICKS.Name: Bag of Tricks

TAUNT.Name: Taunt

TORMENT.Name: Torment

ROAROFTIME.Description: This distorting echo deals half dmg on the user's first 5 turns. Ignores enemy stat changes.

DRACOMETEOR.Name: Draco Meteor
DRACOMETEOR.Description: Pain and devastation. Can't be used in conjunction with allies' moves under 75 BP. High Crit ratio.

OUTRAGE.Name: Outrage
OUTRAGE.Description: The user rampages, Heal Blocking its own team for 4 turns.

ONSLAUGHT.Name: Onslaught
ONSLAUGHT.Description: Rushes down and overwhelms the target. 30% chance to slightly raise the user's Def and Sp. Def.

SPACIALREND.Name: Spacial Rend
SPACIALREND.Description: The user warps the target along with the space around it. Has a 50% chance to Paralyze.

APOTHEOSIS.Name: Apotheosis
APOTHEOSIS.Description: This divine surge has a 50% chance to trigger bonus effects based on the target's type.

HEADHUNT.Name: Headhunt
HEADHUNT.Description: This dire attack deals double damage if the user OR target is Compromised.

FAIRYTAIL.Name: Fairy Tail
FAIRYTAIL.Description: Switches out the target for a random ally. Deals x2 damage on the last active Pokemon.

DRAGONBREATH.Name: Dragon Breath
DRAGONBREATH.Description: This elemental exhalation has a 30% chance to randomly status. x1.5 dmg if Paragon move.

REVELATION.Name: Revelation
REVELATION.Description: This apocalyptic attack reverses all the user's stat changes if any are negative.

TWISTER.Name: Twister
TWISTER.Description: Whips up a storm that damages enemies. Has +20 power for each hazard on the opponent's field.

PAROXYSM.Name: Paroxysm
PAROXYSM.Description: This raging beam inflicts bonus damage equal to half the user's level.

DRAGONDANCE.Name: Dragon Dance
DRAGONDANCE.Description: The user performs a mystic, powerful dance that boosts their Attack and Speed stats.

STYGIANRAID.Name: Stygian Raid
STYGIANRAID.Description: Bursts of lightning detonate as the user crashes down, cutting 4 PP from the last-used move.

THUNDERCLAP.Description: Splits a wicked bolt into the target, but this lowers the user's Attack.

VOLTTACKLE.Name: Volt Tackle
VOLTTACKLE.Description: This signature attack has a 10% chance to Paralyze and 1/3 Recoil Damage.

ZAPCANNON.Name: Zap Cannon
ZAPCANNON.Description: The user fires an electric blast like a cannon to inflict damage and always cause paralysis.

DEFROST.Name: Defrost
DEFROST.Description: Fully restores HP and slightly raises Defense, but the user loses the Ice type for 3 turns.

THUNDERBOLT.Name: Thunderbolt
THUNDERBOLT.Description: Strikes down the target with a crackling lightning bolt. Has a 10% chance to Paralyze.

WILDCHARGE.Name: Wild Charge

LIGHTNINGCHAIN.Name: Lightning Chain

THUNDERFANG.Name: Thunder Fang
THUNDERFANG.Description: The user bites with electrified fangs that have a 20% chance to Paralyze or make the target flinch.

CHARGEBEAM.Name: Charge Beam

FOCUSBLAST.Name: Focus Blast
FOCUSBLAST.Description: The user channels their essence into an energy blast. Has a 30% chance to raise the user's Sp. Def.

SUPERPOWER.Description: Attacks with superhuman strength, but slightly lowers the user's Attack, Defense, and Acc.

SACREDSWORD.Description: The might of this paladin's blade grants a Safeguards to the user's team for 3 turns.

SECRETSWORD.Description: Uses the target's lower base defending stat. Deals x1.5 dmg if it's their first turn.

SKYUPPERCUT.Name: Sky Uppercut
SKYUPPERCUT.Description: The user rides an uppercut into the sky. Deals super effective damage to Flying types.

SUBMISSION.Name: Submission

KARATECHOP.Name: Karate Chop

POWERVACUUM.Name: Power Vacuum
POWERVACUUM.Description: Fills the power vacuum with suctioning force. Strikes with priority. High Crit ratio.

DOUBLEKICK.Description: Kicks the target twice in succession. Each hit has a 15% flinch chance.

ARMTHRUST.Name: Arm Thrust
ARMTHRUST.Description: Fires 2-4 open-palmed thrusts. Each hit cuts 1 PP from the target's last-used move.

BREAKDANCE.Name: Break Dance

VCREATE.Name: V-create

INQUISITION.Name: Inquisition

DEADAIR.Name: Dead Air

OVERHEAT.Name: Overheat

MAGMACONE.Name: Magma Cone

EXSANGUINATE.Name: Exsanguinate

LAVAPLUME.Name: Lava Plume

FIREPUNCH.Name: Fire Punch
FIREPUNCH.Description: The target is punched with a fiery fist that has a 10% chance to Burn the target.

FLAMETONGUE.Name: Flametongue

FIREFANG.Name: Fire Fang

FLAMEWHEEL.Name: Flame Wheel

FLAMECHARGE.Name: Flame Charge

TUNNELNETWORK.Name: Tunnel Network

INCINERATE.Name: Incinerate
INCINERATE.Description: Gouts concentrated fire, destroying the target's item. Deals 1/2 dmg to itemless targets.

HEATCRASH.Name: Heat Crash
HEATCRASH.Description: The user smashes into the target. The heavier the user is than the target, the greater the power.

SUNNYDAY.Name: Sunny Day
SUNNYDAY.Description: Intensified sun empowers Fire-type moves and weakens Water-type moves for 8 turns.

WILLOWISP.Name: Will-O-Wisp
WILLOWISP.Description: The user emits a sinister, bluish-white flame at the target to inflict a Burn.

HYDRAULICLIFT.Name: Hydraulic Lift
HYDRAULICLIFT.Description: Uses pistons to expulse the target, always resulting in a Critical hit.

BRAVEBIRD.Name: Brave Bird
BRAVEBIRD.Description: The user tucks in their wings and charges from low altitude. Has 1/3 Recoil Damage.

HURRICANE.Name: Hurricane

SKYSCRAPER.Name: Sky Scraper

JUNGLEFEVER.Name: Jungle Fever

STRATOSPHERE.Description: The user expands a sphere of ozone which extends the duration of active weather by 4 turns.

GUST.Name: Gust
GUST.Description: Whips up wind that damages enemies. Has +20 power for each hazard on the opponent's field.

MEATHOOKS.Name: Meat Hooks

OMINOUSWIND.Name: Ominous Wind

SHADOWBOX.Name: Shadow Box
SHADOWBOX.Description: Throws feinting punches to break the target's spirit. 30% chance to Torment. Never misses.

HEX.Name: Hex
HEX.Description: This vile attack does double damage to Compromised targets.

JUMPSCARE.Name: Jump Scare

LICK.Name: Lick
LICK.Description: Gets a taste of the target's tendencies, always raising the user's Sp. Def.

EFFIGY.Name: Effigy

TROPKICK.Name: Trop Kick
TROPKICK.Description: This strange dropkick attack uses the target's lower base defending stat.

SOLARBEAM.Name: Solar Beam
SOLARBEAM.Description: Gathers light the first turn, then fires a powerful energy beam. Executes in one turn in Sun.

LOGJAM.Name: Log Jam
LOGJAM.Description: Deals x2 dmg against trapped targets or after trapping targets 3x. Has 1/3 Recoil Damage.

HEDGECLIPPERS.Name: Hedge Clippers
HEDGECLIPPERS.Description: The power of shrubbery. Has a 70% chance to lower the target's Defense. High Crit ratio.

ENERGYBALL.Name: Energy Ball
ENERGYBALL.Description: Draws nature into a blast with a 50% chance to lower Crit Ratio. Power doubles in any Terrain.

SEEDBOMB.Name: Seed Bomb
SEEDBOMB.Description: The user barrages all enemies with hard-shelled seeds. Has a 20% flinch chance.

GIGADRAIN.Name: Giga Drain
GIGADRAIN.Description: Drains nutrients, restoring HP equal to damage dealt. Deals double damage if the user has full HP.

CROWNOFHORNS.Name: Crown of Horns
CROWNOFHORNS.Description: Lances the target with prickly horns. 50% chance to steal 1 Crit Ratio from the target.

NATURESCALL.Name: Nature's Call
NATURESCALL.Description: Heed the call. An enemy's next non-STAB super effective attack deals x0.66 damage. Stacks 8x.

THAUMATURGY.Name: Thaumaturgy
THAUMATURGY.Description: These magical herbs have a 30% chance to Enchant. Never misses. x1.5 dmg if Paragon move.

NEEDLEARM.Name: Needle Arm
NEEDLEARM.Description: The user rends the target with thorns or spines, inflicting grievous wounds for 5 turns.

DECIDUOUSDROP.Name: Deciduous Drop
DECIDUOUSDROP.Description: The user sheds their Grass type for 3 turns, making its target Grass type instead.

PIGEONHOLE.Name: Pigeonhole
PIGEONHOLE.Description: This career-ruining, typecasting attack deals half damage to single-typed targets.

PHOENIXFLOWER.Name: Phoenix Flower
PHOENIXFLOWER.Description: This snapdragon breath slightly lowers Defense and Sp. Def. Super effective against Fire-types.

VINESNARE.Name: Vine Snare
VINESNARE.Description: Entangles the target. Your team's next attack from a Rock-type deals 1/3 Max HP damage. Stacks 8x.

BULLETSEED.Name: Bullet Seed
BULLETSEED.Description: Rifles 2-4 sharp seeds, or 3-5 if Seeds of Doubt is on the enemy field.

COMPOSTING.Name: Composting
COMPOSTING.Description: Turns the opponent into compost! This recycles the next item used or consumed by the user's team.

GRASSKNOT.Name: Grass Knot
GRASSKNOT.Description: The user snares and topples the target. Damage scales with the target's weight.

AROMATHERAPY.Name: Aromatherapy
AROMATHERAPY.Description: Uses homeopathic remedies to cure all status conditions in the user's party. Can be used while asleep.

COTTONGUARD.Name: Cotton Guard
COTTONGUARD.Description: The user wraps their body in soft cotton. It drastically raises their Defense.

COTTONSPORE.Name: Cotton Spores
COTTONSPORE.Description: Releases various spores containing Composting, Nature's Call, and Zone Control phazards.

DREEPYROCKET.Name: Dreepy Rocket
DREEPYROCKET.Description: The user fires a Dreepy like a missile. Has a 30% Burn chance.

INGRAIN.Name: Ingrain
INGRAIN.Description: Lowers Speed, but raises Defenses with Priority. Restores 1/12th Max HP every turn. User is trapped.

LEECHSEED.Name: Leech Seed
LEECHSEED.Description: A seed is planted on the target that saps 1/8th Max HP from them each turn.

SLEEPPOWDER.Name: Sleep Powder
SLEEPPOWDER.Description: The user scatters dust around the target that induces Sleep for 2 turns.

DEEPCELLAR.Name: Deep Cellar
DEEPCELLAR.Description: The user locks the target underground in cold storage, Freezing them.

STUNSPORE.Name: Stun Spore
STUNSPORE.Description: The user scatters a cloud of numbing powder that Paralyzes the target.

LEYLINELUSTER.Name: Ley Line Luster
LEYLINELUSTER.Description: The user draws in luminous energy in a pattern that raises their Sp. Attack and Speed.

SEEDSOFDOUBT.Name: Seeds of Doubt
SEEDSOFDOUBT.Description: Scatters seeds which change the Abilities of opposing Pokémon switching in to Anxiety.

EARTHQUAKE.Name: Earthquake
EARTHQUAKE.Description: Sets off a quake that damages everything around, but this lowers the user's Sp. Atk.

EARTHPOWER.Name: Earth Power
EARTHPOWER.Description: The user makes the ground under the target erupt. 20% chance to lower their Sp. Def.

UNDERMINE.Name: Undermine
UNDERMINE.Description: Burrows the first turn, then attacks. Has +10 power for each of the target's stat changes.

DRILLRUN.Name: Drill Run
DRILLRUN.Description: The user drills into the target at high speed. Power doubles in any Terrain.

BONECLUB.Name: Bone Club
BONECLUB.Description: The user clubs the target with a bone. It always lowers their Attack.

MUDBOMB.Name: Mud Bomb
MUDBOMB.Description: Launches a hard-packed mud ball to attack. Has a 50% chance to lower the target's Accuracy.

BULLDOZE.Name: Bulldoze
BULLDOZE.Description: This leveling attack eliminates all field-wide effects like Terrains and Pillars of Law.

MUDFLAPS.Name: Mud Flaps
MUDFLAPS.Description: The user jettisons heavy mud at the target. They move last in their priority bracket for 3 turns.

BONEMERANG.Name: Bonemerang
BONEMERANG.Description: The user throws a bone which smacks down Flying targets.

SANDTOMB.Name: Sand Tomb
SANDTOMB.Description: Traps the target in a coffin of sand for 3 turns, dealing 1/6th Max HP damage each turn.

BONERUSH.Name: Bone Rush
BONERUSH.Description: Bones the target 2-4 times in a row. Gains 1 BP per target's missing PP.

MUDBATH.Name: Mud Bath
MUDBATH.Description: Your team uses its higher defensive stat and restores 2 PP per turn for 8 turns.

TERRAFORMING.Name: Terraforming
TERRAFORMING.Description: Expands the earth, extending the duration of effects like Gravity and Terrains by 4 turns.

COLLISIONCOURSE.Name: Collision Course
COLLISIONCOURSE.Description: Explodes with high-speed power that generates a Pheromone Blur for 3 turns.

SPINVELOCITY.Name: Spin Velocity
SPINVELOCITY.Description: Uses otherworldly rotational force to generate artificial Gravity for 3 turns.

SANDATTACK.Name: Sand Attack
SANDATTACK.Description: Sand is hurled in the targets' faces, reducing their Accuracy.

SPIKES.Name: Spikes
SPIKES.Description: Scatters spikes that damage opponents switching into battle by 1/10th Max HP. Can stack 3x.

ROYALJELLY.Name: Royal Jelly
ROYALJELLY.Description: Attacks with a secretion that raises your team's next stat gain(s) 1 extra stage. Stacks 8x.

SOFTSERVE.Name: Soft Serve
SOFTSERVE.Description: Attacks with ice cream that raises your team's next stat gain(s) 1 extra stage. Stacks 8x.

BLIZZARD.Name: Blizzard
BLIZZARD.Description: A howling blizzard is summoned to pummel the surrounding area. Has a 30% Freeze chance.

ICEBEAM.Name: Ice Beam
ICEBEAM.Description: The target is struck with an ice-cold energy beam that has a 10% Freeze chance.

ICICLECRASH.Name: Icicle Crash
ICICLECRASH.Description: The user attacks by dropping large icicles onto its target. Has a 30% Freeze chance.

ICEPUNCH.Name: Ice Punch
ICEPUNCH.Description: The target is punched with an icy fist that has a 10% Freeze chance.

AURORABEAM.Name: Aurora Beam
AURORABEAM.Description: Mesmerizing. Slightly raises Sp. Atk, then converts the user's stat raises into turns of Aurora Veil.

GLACIATE.Name: Glaciate
GLACIATE.Description: The user exhausts a vortex of freezing emptiness at opposing Pokémon. 50% Freeze chance.

ICEFANG.Name: Ice Fang
ICEFANG.Description: The user bites with icy fangs. Has a 20% chance to Freeze or flinch the target.

AVALANCHE.Name: Avalanche
AVALANCHE.Description: Crashes down with a mighty avalanche, but traps the user. If it misses, the user loses 50% Max HP.

COLDFRONT.Name: Cold Front
COLDFRONT.Description: This vortex of icy winds slightly reduces opponents' Speed for 3 turns.

FROSTBREATH.Name: Frost Breath
FROSTBREATH.Description: The user exhales pure ice on the target, always resulting in a Critical hit.

ICESHARD.Name: Ice Shard
ICESHARD.Description: Lays an ice stake with priority that KO's any enemy under 1/16 of their Max HP. Stacks 8x.

POWDERSNOW.Name: Powder Snow
POWDERSNOW.Description: The user kicks up a blinding cloud of powdery snow, lowering targets' Accuracy.

EPICSNOWBALL.Name: Epic Snowball
EPICSNOWBALL.Description: Rolls a snowball downhill that has +35 power for each consecutive momentum move used.

RIMESPITTER.Name: Rime Spitter
RIMESPITTER.Description: Spits rime at the target 2-4 times in a row. Each has a 10% Freeze chance.

VERGLAS.Name: Verglas
VERGLAS.Description: The user coats itself in a sheen of ice that slightly raises Attack, Defense, Sp. Atk, and Sp. Def.

HAIL.Name: Hail
HAIL.Description: Calls a wintry storm which lasts 8 turns. It damages all Pokémon except Ice-types.

HAZE.Name: Haze
HAZE.Description: Eliminates enemy stat and crit raises while restoring your stat and crit drops for 3 turns.

PARESTHESIA.Name: Paresthesia
PARESTHESIA.Description: For 5 turns, opponents take x0.8 damage but are frozen at the end of each turn.

EXPLOSION.Name: Explosion
EXPLOSION.Description: Uses the higher attacking stat to blast everything around the user. The user faints.

SELFDESTRUCT.Name: Self-Destruct
SELFDESTRUCT.Description: Boom. Uses the highest attacking stat to blast everything around the user. The user faints.

GIGAIMPACT.Name: Giga Impact
GIGAIMPACT.Description: Giga Chad. Eliminates all field-wide effects like Terrains. Requires a recharge turn.

HYPERBEAM.Name: Hyper Beam
HYPERBEAM.Description: This powerful beam triggers any Pseudo Hazard on the opponent's field. Requires a recharge turn.

LASTRESORT.Name: Last Resort
LASTRESORT.Description: This desperation attack can be used only after all its other moves have been used at least once.

DOUBLEEDGE.Name: Double-Edge
DOUBLEEDGE.Description: A reckless assault that has 1/3 Recoil Damage unless it critically hits.

HEADCHARGE.Name: Head Charge
HEADCHARGE.Description: A gloriously smashing headbutt of blissful pomp and magnificence. Has 1/4 Recoil Damage.

CURBSTOMP.Name: Curb Stomp
CURBSTOMP.Description: Has a 20% flinch chance. Deals half dmg unless there's been Dark-type dmg this battle.

MIRACLE.Name: Miracle
MIRACLE.Description: The user cuts 1/4 Max HP; the next ally that would be KO'd endures the attack with 1 HP.

EGGBOMB.Name: Egg Bomb
EGGBOMB.Description: Haha! Egg on your face! Your team's next Normal-type attack steals 1/4 Max HP. Stacks 8x.

JUDGMENT.Name: Judgment
JUDGMENT.Description: The user smites the target with divine punishment. This move's type matches the user's held Plate.

FERALFERVOR.Name: Feral Fervor
FERALFERVOR.Description: Attacks with a wild, fighting aura that drastically raises all targets' lowest attacking stat.

CHROMATICORB.Name: Chromatic Orb
CHROMATICORB.Description: This light-bending sphere has a 50% chance to trigger bonus effects based on the target's type.

LUMINACRASH.Name: Lumina Crash
LUMINACRASH.Description: This collision of shimmering light has a 50% chance to slightly lower the target's Atk and Sp. Atk.

TAKEDOWN.Name: Take Down
TAKEDOWN.Description: This strong tackle deals x1.5 dmg to targets on their first turn. Has 1/4th Recoil Damage.

BOOMBURST.Name: Boomburst
BOOMBURST.Description: The user reverberates with a terrible, destructive cacophony for 3 turns, then becomes Confused.

BODYSLAM.Name: Body Slam
BODYSLAM.Description: The user throws themself with their full body weight. Has a 30% chance to Paralyze.

TECHNOBLAST.Name: Techno Blast
TECHNOBLAST.Description: The user fires a beam of light. The move's type changes depending on the Drive the user holds.

EXTREMESPEED.Name: Extreme Speed
EXTREMESPEED.Description: The user charges the target at blinding speed. This move strikes with high priority.

HYPERFANG.Name: Hyper Fang
HYPERFANG.Description: Attacks with an underdog spirit and large front fangs. Has a 20% chance to raise the user's Attack.

GASKETBLOWER.Name: Gasket Blower
GASKETBLOWER.Description: Attacks last by building up steam then blowing a gasket. Disables the target's last-used move.

RAZORWIND.Name: Razor Wind
RAZORWIND.Description: Blades of wind slice up opposing Pokémon, always raising the user's Atk.

WHIPLASH.Name: Whiplash
WHIPLASH.Description: If the user goes second, they inflict x1.5 dmg taken from their last attack. Builds Momentum.

DESOLATION.Name: Desolation
DESOLATION.Description: The user devastates the area. 30% chance to Poison anyone hit. Never misses in Smog.

TRIATTACK.Name: Tri Attack
TRIATTACK.Description: The user strikes with a 3-beam attack. 30% chance to Burn, Freeze, or Paralyze the target.

RARETALON.Name: Rare Talon
RARETALON.Description: The user crushes the target with claws. 70% chance to lower the target's Defense.

HYMNOFFAITH.Name: Hymn of Faith
HYMNOFFAITH.Description: The user performs a deeply moving song using their higher attacking stat.

CHIPAWAY.Name: Chip Away
CHIPAWAY.Description: A 3-part attack. Each hit is 15 BP stronger than the last. Super effective against Rock-types.

DIZZYPUNCH.Name: Dizzy Punch
DIZZYPUNCH.Description: The target is struck with a whimsical haymaker that always Confuses them.

FACADE.Name: Facade
FACADE.Description: A crafty attack that deals x2 damage if the user is Compromised. Breaks protection; never misses.

BUTTERFLYKNIFE.Name: Butterfly Knife
BUTTERFLYKNIFE.Description: This fanciful blade slightly raises the target's Defense and then uses it as your attacking stat.

RETALIATE.Name: Retaliate
RETALIATE.Description: The user seeks revenge. Unless an ally fainted on the previous turn, it deals half damage.

SECRETPOWER.Name: Secret Power
SECRETPOWER.Description: This attack has a 30% chance to deal additional effects based on the Field Effect.

SLASH.Name: Slash
SLASH.Description: The target is slashed with claws or blades. High Crit ratio.

SPLITTINGANTLER.Name: Splitting Antler
SPLITTINGANTLER.Description: Strikes with horns that ignore abilities and transfer negative stat changes to the target.

FAULTLINES.Name: Fault Lines
FAULTLINES.Description: This groundswell deals half dmg on the user's first 5 turns. Ignores enemy stat changes.

COVET.Name: Covet
COVET.Description: This endearing attack steals the target's item. Deals x2 dmg to itemless targets.

LIVINGCOLORS.Name: Living Colors
LIVINGCOLORS.Description: Attacks all enemies with changing colors. Has a 50% chance to steal targets' Accuracy.

HARTSHORN.Name: Hartshorn
HARTSHORN.Description: The user befuddles the target with a powder-infused attack. Has a 30% Confusion chance.

STARPOWER.Name: Star Power
STARPOWER.Description: Allows the next ally's ability like Chlorophyll or Snow Cloak to work without weather. Stacks 8x.

VICEGRIP.Name: Vise Grip
VICEGRIP.Description: Traps and squeezes the target with a vise for 3 turns, dealing 1/6th Max HP damage each turn.

CUTTINGEDGE.Name: Cutting Edge
CUTTINGEDGE.Description: Slices the target with a sharp blade. High Crit ratio. If it crits, it deals x1.5 damage.

STRUGGLE.Name: Struggle
STRUGGLE.Description: This attack is used in desperation only if the user has no PP. Has 1/2 Recoil Damage.

TACKLE.Name: Tackle
TACKLE.Description: The user charges into the target to try to knock them down.

WEATHERBALL.Name: Weather Ball
WEATHERBALL.Description: This attack doubles in power and changes type if there is weather.

ECHOEDVOICE.Name: Echoed Voice
ECHOEDVOICE.Description: The user attacks with an echoing voice. Has +35 power for each consecutive momentum move used.

FAKEOUT.Name: Fake Out
FAKEOUT.Description: This attack hits first and flinches the target, but only works the first turn in battle.

FALSESWIPE.Name: False Swipe
FALSESWIPE.Description: Unless the target is at 1 HP, this restrained attack leaves 1 HP instead of KO'ing.

PAYDAY.Name: Pay Day
PAYDAY.Description: Attacks with gold coins. Your team's next Dragon-type attack deals 1/3 Max HP damage. Stacks 8x.

GROUNDNPOUND.Name: Ground'n Pound
GROUNDNPOUND.Description: Pounds the target into the ground. Always raises the user's Defense

QUICKATTACK.Name: Quick Attack
QUICKATTACK.Description: The user pounces at a speed that makes them almost invisible. Strikes with priority.

BIOHAZARD.Name: Biohazard
BIOHAZARD.Description: This dangerous attack slightly raises the target's Sp. Def and then uses it as your attacking stat.

GIGATONHAMMER.Name: Gigaton Hammer
GIGATONHAMMER.Description: Big hammer go smash. But cannot go smash two turns in a row.

DOUBLETAP.Name: Double Tap
DOUBLETAP.Description: The user smacks up the target with a hand, tail or tentacle. Twice. Each hit has a 15% flinch chance.

ROGUEELEMENT.Name: Rogue Element
ROGUEELEMENT.Description: This perplexing, anti-heroic attack grants your team an extra Paragon Move.

SWEEPSLICE.Name: Sweep Slice
SWEEPSLICE.Description: A graceful rush with a knifelike tail or scarf. Strikes 2-4 times in a row. High Crit ratio.

RAGE.Name: Rage
RAGE.Description: The user assails the target with increasing violence. Always raises the user's Attack.

RAPIDSPIN.Name: Rapid Spin
RAPIDSPIN.Description: A spin attack that also eliminates entry hazards and effects like Bind or Leech Seed.

SPIKECANNON.Name: Spike Cannon
SPIKECANNON.Description: Launches nautical spikes 2-4 times, or 3-5 if Spikes or Toxic Spikes are on the enemy field.

COMETPUNCH.Name: Comet Punch
COMETPUNCH.Description: Launches otherworldly punches 2-4 times. Each has a 10% chance to Enchant.

STRANGLETHORNS.Name: Stranglethorns
STRANGLETHORNS.Description: These rending brambles lay Spikes, then Toxic Spikes, then Seeds of Doubt, but trap the user.

HALFLIFE.Name: Half-Life
HALFLIFE.Description: A rather dated attack, it halves the target's current HP then heals the user for 1/2 damage dealt.

BIND.Name: Bind
BIND.Description: Traps and squeezes the target for 3 turns, dealing 1/6th Max HP damage each turn.

DOUBLESLAP.Name: Double Slap
DOUBLESLAP.Description: Slaps the target back and forth with a sassy attitude. Each hit has a 15% chance to Enchant.

MOODSWINGS.Name: Mood Swings
MOODSWINGS.Description: Attacks by swinging violently. The user changes to and from Psychic-type after use.

SWEETEMBRACE.Name: Sweet Embrace
SWEETEMBRACE.Description: Traps the target with its body, vines, etc. for 3 turns, restoring 1/6th Max HP each turn.

INFRARED.Name: Infrared
INFRARED.Description: The user sees red. Glowing with radiation, this drastically raises their Attack.

BIDE.Name: Bide
BIDE.Description: Does nothing for 2 turns, then delivers double the damage it took over that time. Builds Momentum.

ATLASHOLD.Name: Atlas Hold
ATLASHOLD.Description: Traps the target with a death grip for 3 turns, restoring 1/6th Max HP each turn.

ENDEAVOR.Name: Endeavor
ENDEAVOR.Description: This attack move cuts down the target's HP to equal the user's HP.

FLAIL.Name: Flail
FLAIL.Description: The user thrashes around with strong movements. Damage scales with the user's missing HP.

BLADEGUNNER.Name: Blade Gunner
BLADEGUNNER.Description: Alternating weapons use its higher attacking and the target's lower defending stat. High Crit ratio.

ROCKYPAYLOAD.Name: Rocky Payload
ROCKYPAYLOAD.Description: After 3 turns, deals 1/3rd Max HP scaling Rock-type damage while switching out the target.

HIDDENPOWER.Name: Hidden Power
HIDDENPOWER.Description: A unique attack that varies in type depending on the Pokémon using it.

REIGNOFTERROR.Name: Reign of Terror
REIGNOFTERROR.Description: The user unleashes the power of evil, but leaves Spikes on their own side.

NATURALGIFT.Name: Natural Gift
NATURALGIFT.Description: Uses the higher attacking stat. Your held Berry determines this move's type and power: 70, 85, or 100.

JUBILATION.Name: Jubilation
JUBILATION.Description: This holiday-inspired attack causes residual healing effects to restore 1/16th more HP for 5 turns.

WITCHINGHOUR.Name: Witching Hour
WITCHINGHOUR.Description: Enemies take more damage, increased by each fainted enemy. Fades after 5 non-KO'ing procs.

SONICBOOM.Name: Sonic Boom
SONICBOOM.Description: Its first use each battle has x2 base dmg. Also inflicts bonus dmg equal to half the user's level.

SPITUP.Name: Spit Up
SPITUP.Description: The user releases its stockpiled power. Base Damage equals 50 x the number of Stockpiles.

SUPERFANG.Name: Super Fang
SUPERFANG.Description: Cuts the target's HP in half, consuming their Berry or Leftovers and gaining its effect.

TRUMPCARD.Name: Trump Card
TRUMPCARD.Description: Coming up trumps, this has +10 power for each super effective attack this battle.

RICOCHET.Name: Ricochet
RICOCHET.Description: Uses the target's own velocity against them. The higher the target's Speed, the greater the damage.

AURAWHEEL.Name: Aura Wheel
AURAWHEEL.Description: This move's type changes to Electric if Morpeko is in Full Belly form.

CREPUSCULARRAY.Name: Crepuscular Ray
CREPUSCULARRAY.Description: After 3 turns, deals 1/3rd Max HP scaling Fairy-type damage while switching out your Pokemon.

SILHOUETTE.Name: Silhouette
SILHOUETTE.Description: Casting a long shadow, the user draws all attacks to itself and negates spread damage onto its ally.

SALTCURE.Name: Salt Cure
SALTCURE.Description: Deals 1/10th HP damage to the target each turn, doubled against Water-, Steel-, Ghost-, and Ice-types.

ALLURE.Name: Allure
ALLURE.Description: Uses charismatic charms, a beguiling force, or sorcery to Enchant the target.

BELLYDRUM.Name: Belly Drum
BELLYDRUM.Description: This rhythmic ritual cuts 1/4 Max HP to drastically raise Attack and Sp. Attack each turn for 2 turns.

BLOCK.Name: Block
BLOCK.Description: The user barricades the target, slightly lowering their Atk, Sp. Atk, Speed, and trapping them.

CAMOUFLAGE.Name: Camouflage
CAMOUFLAGE.Description: Gives STAB to and immunes damage from a field effect-dependent type with priority.

CAPTIVATE.Name: Captivate
CAPTIVATE.Description: Charms the target, drastically lowering their Sp. Attack.

CHARM.Name: Charm
CHARM.Description: The user gazes rather charmingly, making the target less wary. This drastically lowers its Attack stat.

GOLDRUSH.Name: Gold Rush
GOLDRUSH.Description: Attacks with piles of glittering, irresistible gold. Has a 50% chance to Enchant the target.

TURBULENCE.Name: Turbulence
TURBULENCE.Description: Funnels the opposing team into choppy winds, slightly reducing their Speed for 3 turns.

COPYCAT.Name: Copycat
COPYCAT.Description: Uses the last-used move from the previous round with x1.5 power, using its higher attacking stat.

DEFENSECURL.Name: Defense Curl
DEFENSECURL.Description: Conceals weak spots with priority to slightly raise Defense and Sp. Defense. Builds Momentum.

DISABLE.Name: Disable
DISABLE.Description: Cuts 1/3rd of the target's HP and disables their last-used move.

INTEGRATIONRAY.Name: Integration Ray
INTEGRATIONRAY.Description: Assimilates parts that bounce back an enemy attack's secondary effect. Stacks 8x.

ENCORE.Name: Encore
ENCORE.Description: Compels the target to keep using its last-used move for 3 turns. Fails in double battles.

ENDURE.Name: Endure
ENDURE.Description: The user endures any attack with at least 1 HP. Its chance of failing doubles if used in succession.

ENTRAINMENT.Name: Entrainment
ENTRAINMENT.Description: Attempts to discipline the target leave it with Truant as its ability.

FLASH.Name: Flash
FLASH.Description: The user emits bright light, lowering targets' Accuracy.

FOCUSENERGY.Name: Focus Energy
FOCUSENERGY.Description: The user takes a deep breath and focuses to sharply raise Critical Hit ratio.

FOLLOWME.Name: Follow Me
FOLLOWME.Description: The user garners attention, raising its Speed. This turn, opponents only target the user.

INSURGENCE.Name: Insurgence
INSURGENCE.Description: The user lashes out with their rebellious attitude, always raising their own Attack.

PETRIFY.Name: Petrify
PETRIFY.Description: Paralyzes the target with its gaze. If it can't be Paralyzed, changes it to Rock-type instead.

GROWL.Name: Growl
GROWL.Description: Grr!!! The user growls at opposing Pokémon, lowering their Attack and Sp. Atk.

GROWTH.Name: Growth
GROWTH.Description: Raises Attack and Sp. Atk, or sharply raises in Rain or Sun. Increases weight based on this increase.

HARDEN.Name: Harden
HARDEN.Description: The user raises Def with priority. Also doubles the power of its Rock-type moves next turn.

HEALBELL.Name: Heal Bell
HEALBELL.Description: The user chimes a soothing bell which cures the status conditions of all party Pokémon.

HELPINGHAND.Name: Helping Hand
HELPINGHAND.Description: The user supports an ally, allowing them to deal double damage this turn.

HOWL.Name: Howl
HOWL.Description: Raises Attack and slightly raises Acc of all allies. For two turns, they heal for 50% damage dealt.

LEER.Name: Leer
LEER.Description: The user gives opposing Pokémon an intimidating leer that lowers their Attack and Defense.

LOCKON.Name: Lock-On
LOCKON.Description: Slightly raises Sp. Atk. Additionally, the user's next 2 attacks never miss and Critically hit.

LOVELYKISS.Name: Lovely Kiss
LOVELYKISS.Description: The user sweeps the target away to Sleep for 2 turns with a dreamy kiss.

LUCKYCHANT.Name: Lucky Chant
LUCKYCHANT.Description: Prevents Crits & secondary effects; raises the team's Crit ratio & secondary effect chance for 8 turns.

MEFIRST.Name: Me First
MEFIRST.Description: If faster, attacks with the target's intended move with x1.5 power. Uses the higher attacking stat.

OUTFLANK.Name: Outflank
OUTFLANK.Description: The user corrals the target, lowering their Atk, Sp. Atk, Speed, and trapping them.

WHEELOFFATE.Name: Wheel of Fate
WHEELOFFATE.Description: The user channels a mysterious power to randomly use nearly any move.

MILKDRINK.Name: Milk Drink
MILKDRINK.Description: Restores 1/2 Max HP or 2/3 if the user has no item. The milk's not chocolate flavored, sadly.

MIMIC.Name: Mimic
MIMIC.Description: Replaces this move with the target's move. Doubles the power of your next 2 moves.

SEANCE.Name: Séance
SEANCE.Description: The user communes with the departed, slightly raising their Accuracy and sharply raising their Sp. Atk.

BLASTINBASTION.Name: Blastin' Bastion
BLASTINBASTION.Description: Boom. Protect this house. Enemies using a switch-out move lose 1/3 Max HP. Stacks 8x.

MOONLIGHT.Name: Moonlight
MOONLIGHT.Description: The user restores 1/2 Max HP. The amount becomes 2/3 under terrain, but 1/4 in weather.

MORNINGSUN.Name: Morning Sun
MORNINGSUN.Description: The user restores 1/2 Max HP. The amount becomes 2/3 in sun, but 1/4 in other weather.

NATUREPOWER.Name: Nature Power
NATUREPOWER.Description: This attack makes use of nature's power. Its effects vary depending on the field effect.

ODORSLEUTH.Name: Odor Sleuth
ODORSLEUTH.Description: Drastically raises the user's Accuracy and allows them to hit immuned types neutrally.

PAINSPLIT.Name: Pain Split
PAINSPLIT.Description: Averages its HP with the target's, then shares its Compromising effects with them.

PERISHSONG.Name: Perish Song
PERISHSONG.Description: Faints the target in 3 turns. Higher-leveled targets take longer to faint.

PROTECT.Name: Protect
PROTECT.Description: Enables the user to evade all attacks. Its chance of failing doubles if used in succession.

PSYCHUP.Name: Psych Up
PSYCHUP.Description: The user heals for 1/4th HP, then if any are negative, reverses all its stat changes.

RECOVER.Name: Recover
RECOVER.Description: Regenerating their own cells, the user restores 1/2 Max HP.

RECYCLE.Name: Recycle
RECYCLE.Description: Recycles the user's consumed held item, then restores 1/4th Max HP if it isn't a Berry.

FAUSTIANBARGAIN.Name: Faustian Bargain
FAUSTIANBARGAIN.Description: The user makes a deal to become the target's type, leaving the target a Ghost type instead.

REFRESH.Name: Refresh
REFRESH.Description: Cures any status or Compromising effects, then heals for 1/4 Max HP. Can be used while asleep.

ROAR.Name: Roar
ROAR.Description: Switches out all enemies for different random Pokémon in the opponent's party.

SAFEGUARD.Name: Safeguard
SAFEGUARD.Description: Safeguards the user's team from all Status and Compromising effects for 8 turns.

SCARETACTICS.Name: Scare Tactics
SCARETACTICS.Description: The user's visage makes all opponents more wary, drastically lowering their Speed.

SCREECH.Name: Screech
SCREECH.Description: An earsplitting screech that drastically lowers targets' Defense.

SHARPEN.Name: Sharpen
SHARPEN.Description: The user hones their edges, raising their Speed, Accuracy, and Crit ratio.

SHELLSMASH.Name: Shell Smash
SHELLSMASH.Description: The user drastically lowers Defense and Sp. Def to drastically raise Attack, Sp. Atk, and Speed.

PHEROMONEBLUR.Name: Pheromone Blur
PHEROMONEBLUR.Description: For 8 turns, a strange aerosol switches STAB/non-STAB moves and damages genderless Pokemon.

LULLABY.Name: Lullaby
LULLABY.Description: A soothing song puts the target into a deep slumber.

INDUSTRIALGRADE.Name: Industrial Grade
INDUSTRIALGRADE.Description: Doubles the effects of the user's team's non-consumable held items for 8 turns.

SLACKOFF.Name: Slack Off
SLACKOFF.Description: The user slacks off to restore full HP, but this lowers their Sp. Defense.

SLEEPTALK.Name: Sleep Talk
SLEEPTALK.Description: While asleep, the user randomly uses one of the other moves they know.

SMOKESCREEN.Name: Smokescreen
SMOKESCREEN.Description: The user releases an obscuring cloud of smoke or ink, cutting targets' Accuracy.

SOFTBOILED.Name: Soft-Boiled
SOFTBOILED.Description: The user soft-boils themselves to restore full HP, but this lowers their Defense.

SPLASH.Name: Splash
SPLASH.Description: The user splashes lots of water, cutting the targets' Accuracy.

STOCKPILE.Name: Stockpile
STOCKPILE.Description: Builds up reserves, slightly raising both Defenses. Can be used up to 3x with increasing effectiveness.

SUBSTITUTE.Name: Substitute
SUBSTITUTE.Description: Makes a substitute using 1/4 Max HP which prevents the user from being damaged or statused until broken.

DOPPLEREFFECT.Name: Doppler Effect
DOPPLEREFFECT.Description: This frequency-changing attack extends the duration of active weather by 4 turns.

SWAGGER.Name: Swagger
SWAGGER.Description: Puffs up the target by sharply raising their Attack, lowering their Accuracy and Confusing them.

SWALLOW.Name: Swallow
SWALLOW.Description: Heals the user by 1/3 or 2/3 Max HP based on Stockpiles. Max effect also cures status.

BONFIRE.Name: Bonfire
BONFIRE.Description: Fuels a Bonfire that slightly raises the Atk and Sp. Atk of the next 3 allies switching in. Stacks 3x.

SWEETSCENT.Name: Sweet Scent
SWEETSCENT.Description: The user wafts a fragrance, raising its Sp. Def. This turn, opponents only target the user.

SWORDSDANCE.Name: Swords Dance
SWORDSDANCE.Description: A frenetic dance to uplift the fighting spirit. This sharply raises the user's Attack.

TAILWHIP.Name: Tail Whip
TAILWHIP.Description: The user brushes their tail across opposing Pokémon, lowering their Defense and Sp. Defense.

TEETERTOTTER.Name: Teeter Totter
TEETERTOTTER.Description: Performs a wobbly dance that Confuses all other Pokémon and lowers their Evasion.

TICKLE.Name: Tickle
TICKLE.Description: The user tickles the target into a fit, changing its ability to Contrary.

TRANSFORM.Name: Transform
TRANSFORM.Description: The user transforms into a copy of the target right down to having the same move set.

WHIRLWIND.Name: Whirlwind
WHIRLWIND.Description: Switches out all enemies for different random Pokémon in the opponent's party.

WISH.Name: Wish
WISH.Description: One turn after using this move, the user's or their replacement's HP is restored by half the user's max HP.

WORKUP.Name: Work Up
WORKUP.Description: Raises Attack and Sp. Atk, or sharply raises if an ally fainted on the previous turn.

GAPINGYAWN.Name: Gaping Yawn
GAPINGYAWN.Description: Hearing this ensorcelled yawn will lull the target into a 2 turn Sleep after their next turn.

LETHALINJECTION.Name: Lethal Injection
LETHALINJECTION.Description: The user pierces the target with a virulent toxin. Always badly Poisons if it hits.

CHEMICALWARFARE.Name: Chemical Warfare
CHEMICALWARFARE.Description: This unsanctioned, reprehensible attack has a 50% chance to randomly status both user and target.

SLUDGEBOMB.Name: Sludge Bomb
SLUDGEBOMB.Description: Unsanitary sludge is hurled at the target. Has a 30% chance to Poison.

POISONJAB.Name: Poison Jab
POISONJAB.Description: The target is jabbed with a tentacle or arm steeped in poison. Has a 30% chance to Poison.

CROSSTAMINATE.Name: Cross-taminate
CROSSTAMINATE.Description: This gruesome, cross-contaminating attack has a 50% chance to steal 1 Crit Ratio from the target.

PICKYOURPOISON.Name: Pick your Poison
PICKYOURPOISON.Description: Gains +40 dmg per: terrain is active; every 3rd turn; Compromised target; target under 1/2 HP.

VENOSHOCK.Name: Venoshock
VENOSHOCK.Description: The user triggers septic shock, disabling the target's moves' secondary effects.

FUNGALSPORES.Name: Fungal Spores
FUNGALSPORES.Description: Living spores reset the target's stat and crit boosts while restoring your drops.

SNAKEBITE.Name: Snakebite
SNAKEBITE.Description: The user bites with envenomed fangs. 20% chance to badly Poison or flinch the target.

TAILEND.Name: Tail End
TAILEND.Description: Lays a phazard that Poisons and drops Crit Rate of an enemy that Crits your team to -4. Stacks 8x.

ACID.Name: Acid
ACID.Description: Splashes acid that slightly lowers Defense and Sp. Def. Super effective against Steel-types.

ATAXIA.Name: Ataxia
ATAXIA.Description: Splashes acid at the target that lowers Defense and Sp. Def. Super effective against Steel-types.

SMOG.Name: Smog
SMOG.Description: Pollutes the field for 8 turns, hurting all combatants except for Poison- and Steel-types.

POISONSTING.Name: Poison Sting
POISONSTING.Description: Stabs with a venomous stinger. Has a 30% chance to Poison. x1.5 dmg if Paragon move.

ACIDARMOR.Name: Acid Armor
ACIDARMOR.Description: The user alters their cellular structure to sharply raise Defense and heal for 1/4 Max HP.

COIL.Name: Coil
COIL.Description: The user winds themselves into a tight coil, drastically raising their Sp. Defense.

GASTROACID.Name: Gastro Acid
GASTROACID.Description: Pukes up stomach acids that suppresses the target's Ability.

FALLOUT.Name: Fallout
FALLOUT.Description: Hazardous air is wafted toward opposing Pokémon, Poisoning them.

POISONPOWDER.Name: Poison Powder
POISONPOWDER.Description: The user scatters a cloud of poisonous dust with priority that Poisons the target.

TOXIC.Name: Toxic
TOXIC.Description: A move that leaves the target badly Poisoned, dealing 1/16th bonus damage every turn.

TOXICSPIKES.Name: Toxic Spikes
TOXICSPIKES.Description: Scatters spikes that Poison opposing Pokémon switching into battle. 2 layers badly Poisons.

GUARDDUTY.Name: Guard Duty
GUARDDUTY.Description: This vigilant ward heals active teammates by 1/8th Max HP each turn. Fades after 5 procs.

DREAMEATER.Name: Dream Eater
DREAMEATER.Description: Restores HP equal to 1/2 dmg dealt. Deals double dmg to sleeping or Witching Hour targets.

FUTURESIGHT.Name: Future Sight
FUTURESIGHT.Description: After 3 turns, causes the opponent's next attack to backfire, dealing double Confusion damage.

PSYSTRIKE.Name: Psystrike
PSYSTRIKE.Description: Materializes psychic bolts to obliterate the target. Uses their lower base defending stat.

THOUGHTBOMB.Name: Thought Bomb
THOUGHTBOMB.Description: The user channels and detonates their own energy. Has 1/4th Recoil Damage and a 20% flinch chance.

EXTRASENSORY.Name: Extrasensory
EXTRASENSORY.Description: This hypersensitivity makes residual damage effects, except weather, deal 1/16th more damage for 5 turns.

PSYSHOCK.Name: Psyshock
PSYSHOCK.Description: Attacks with a jilting psychic current that uses the target's lower base defending stat.

ZENHEADBUTT.Name: Zen Headbutt
ZENHEADBUTT.Description: The user focuses their psychic power into a headbutt that always raises their own Sp. Atk.

LUSTERPURGE.Name: Luster Purge
LUSTERPURGE.Description: Looses a psychic blast of light that damages everything around, but lowers the user's Attack.

BELLRINGER.Name: Bell Ringer
BELLRINGER.Description: Ding dong! This concussive blow prevents the target from using any status moves for 3 turns.

MENTALEDGE.Name: Mental Edge
MENTALEDGE.Description: If this crits, gain a psychological advantage by slightly lowering enemy Sp. Atk for 3 turns.

FULLTHROTTLE.Name: Full Throttle
FULLTHROTTLE.Description: The user nitro boosts its cylinders, raising its Atk and Sp. Atk. Costs 1/2 Max HP in recoil.

STRESSTEST.Name: Stress Test
STRESSTEST.Description: This pressure-inducing attack cuts 4 PP from the target's last-used move.

HEARTBREAKER.Name: Heart Breaker
HEARTBREAKER.Description: Crushes the target's heart with an irresistible force. Deals half damage to Genderless Pokemon.

CREEPINGDOUBT.Name: Creeping Doubt
CREEPINGDOUBT.Description: Reduces the PP of the next enemy's move that misses to 1. Stacks 8x. High Crit ratio.

MIRRORCOAT.Name: Mirror Coat
MIRRORCOAT.Description: Goes second, inflicting double the damage taken from any special attack. Builds Momentum.

PSYWAVE.Name: Psywave
PSYWAVE.Description: This subsonic wave extends the duration of effects like Gravity and Terrains by 4 turns.

STOREDPOWER.Name: Stored Power
STOREDPOWER.Description: The user activates its immense dormant power. Gains/loses 10 power for each stat boost/reduction.

AGILITY.Name: Agility
AGILITY.Description: Drastically raises the user's Speed, or maxes it if the user isn't holding an item.

FROSTEDGLASS.Name: Frosted Glass
FROSTEDGLASS.Description: A beautiful attack which deals x2 damage if a screen like Reflect or Safeguard is active for either team.

AMNESIA.Name: Amnesia
AMNESIA.Description: The user empties their mind to sharply raise their Sp. Def and heal for 1/4 Max HP.

CRATERMAKER.Name: Crater Maker
CRATERMAKER.Description: The user ruptures the ground in a frenzy for 3 turns, then becomes Confused.

CALMMIND.Name: Calm Mind
CALMMIND.Description: The user reaches new levels of mind and spirit, raising their Sp. Attack and Sp. Defense.

COSMICPOWER.Name: Cosmic Power
COSMICPOWER.Description: Absorbs a mystical power from space to raise Defense and Sp. Def.

GRAVITY.Name: Gravity
GRAVITY.Description: Creates a grounding field that damages Compromised Pokemon for 1/8 Max HP for 8 turns.

RAINBOWROBE.Name: Rainbow Robe
RAINBOWROBE.Description: This deluge of rainbow droplets first slightly raises the target's Sp. Def.

GUARDSWAP.Name: Guard Swap
GUARDSWAP.Description: The user employs psychic power to exchange its Defense and Sp. Def stats with its target's.

HEALBLOCK.Name: Heal Block
HEALBLOCK.Description: The user prevents all enemies from using moves, Abilities, or held items to recover HP for 8 turns.

HEALPULSE.Name: Heal Pulse
HEALPULSE.Description: Emits pulses that heal the target by 2/3 of the user's Max HP while restoring their stat drops.

HEALINGWISH.Name: Healing Wish
HEALINGWISH.Description: The user faints. The Pokémon taking their place will have its HP restored and status conditions cured.

COMPOUNDGAS.Name: Compound Gas
COMPOUNDGAS.Description: This gas influences the next 5 procs of full Paralysis, Freeze, or Confusion in your favor.

HYPNOSIS.Name: Hypnosis
HYPNOSIS.Description: The user employs hypnotic suggestion to make the target fall into a deep Sleep for 2 turns.

MENTALBLOCK.Name: Mental Block
MENTALBLOCK.Description: Disables any moves the target knows that are also known by the user.

TELEKINESIS.Name: Telekinesis
TELEKINESIS.Description: Uses Telekinesis to trigger a Pseudo Hazard, such as Vine Snare, on the opponent's field.

DOUBLEHELIX.Name: Double Helix
DOUBLEHELIX.Description: Attacks twice with DNA. Each hit has a 30% chance to erect 1 turn of Reflect or Light Screen.

LUNARDANCE.Name: Lunar Dance
LUNARDANCE.Description: The user faints. The Pokémon taking their place will have its status, HP, and PP fully restored.

MAGICCOAT.Name: Magic Coat
MAGICCOAT.Description: Cuts 1/2 Max HP with +4 priority to erect a magic-bouncing screen for the user's team for 5 turns.

CONTAGION.Name: Contagion
CONTAGION.Description: This virulent plague deals half dmg on the user's first 5 turns. Ignores enemy stat changes.

MEDITATE.Name: Meditate
MEDITATE.Description: Enters a trance to raise Attack, Def, Sp. Atk, Sp. Def, Speed, and Acc. Requires a recharge turn.

RECONNAISSANCE.Name: Reconnaissance
RECONNAISSANCE.Description: Stealths the first turn, then drastically raises its lowest stat the second turn.

EPIDEMIC.Name: Epidemic
EPIDEMIC.Description: Transfers its status to targets. Deals half dmg unless there's been Fighting-type dmg this battle.

POWERSWAP.Name: Strength Swap
POWERSWAP.Description: The user employs psychic power to exchange its Attack and Sp. Atk stats with its target's.

CURTAINCALL.Name: Curtain Call
CURTAINCALL.Description: Faints the target in 3 turns. Higher-leveled targets take longer to faint.

INCEPTION.Name: Inception
INCEPTION.Description: The user enters the target's head, shifting their own Compromising conditions to them.

REPULSOR.Name: Repulsor
REPULSOR.Description: Creates 5 turns of Reflect or Light Screen, depending on the enemy's best attacking stat.

REST.Name: Rest
REST.Description: Fully restores the user's HP and status conditions, but the user goes to Sleep for 2 turns.

ROLEPLAY.Name: Role Play
ROLEPLAY.Description: The user role plays, copying the target's Ability and stealing 2 Sp. Attack.

SKILLSWAP.Name: Skill Swap
SKILLSWAP.Description: The user employs their psychic power to switch abilities and stat stage changes with the target.

UNSEENFIST.Name: Unseen Fist
UNSEENFIST.Description: Uses the target's lower base defending stat. Deals x1.5 dmg if it's their first turn.

TELEPORT.Name: Teleport
TELEPORT.Description: The user lowers the target's Accuracy, then teleports out for another Pokémon.

SWITCHEROO.Name: Switcheroo
SWITCHEROO.Description: The user catches the target off guard and swaps held items with them.

TRICKROOM.Name: Trick Room
TRICKROOM.Description: Creates a bizarre area in which slower Pokémon move first for 5 turns.

WONDERROOM.Name: Wonder Room
WONDERROOM.Description: The user makes other field-wide effects like Weather or Gravity disappear for 8 turns.

RUBBLEBLUDGEON.Name: Rubble Bludgeon
RUBBLEBLUDGEON.Description: This punishing attack has +10 power for each of the target's stat changes.

ROCKWRECKER.Name: Rock Wrecker
ROCKWRECKER.Description: This cataclysmic attack destroys Terrains, Pseudo Hazards, and Pillars of Law, but costs 1/2 Max HP in recoil.

GASHINGCRAGS.Name: Gashing Crags
GASHINGCRAGS.Description: This jagged attack deals 1/8th HP dmg if the user has stat boosts and no reductions. High Crit ratio.

LANDSLIDE.Name: Land Slide
LANDSLIDE.Description: Dumps large boulders onto enemies. Has +10 power for each hazard on the opponent's field.

POWERGEM.Name: Power Gem
POWERGEM.Description: Shines a powerful gemstone ray. 30% chance to Enchant its targets. Never misses in Sun.

ANCIENTPOWER.Name: Ancient Power
ANCIENTPOWER.Description: The user attacks with a prehistoric power that transfers status conditions to the target.

SCATTERSHOT.Name: Scattershot
SCATTERSHOT.Description: Fires buckshot that gains bonus damage and effects based on hazards on your field.

ROCKTOMB.Name: Rock Tomb
ROCKTOMB.Description: Lowers the target's Speed. Deals x2 dmg against trapped targets or after trapping targets 3x.

CLIFFHANGER.Name: Cliff Hanger
CLIFFHANGER.Description: Unless the target is at 1 HP, this plot device leaves 1 HP instead of KO'ing.

ROLLINGSTONE.Name: Rolling Stone
ROLLINGSTONE.Description: Gathering no moss, this move has +35 power for each consecutive momentum move used.

ROCKBLAST.Name: Rock Blast
ROCKBLAST.Description: Propels a barrage of 2-4 rocks, or 3-5 if Stealth Rock is on the enemy field.

ROCKPOLISH.Name: Rock Polish
ROCKPOLISH.Description: The user polishes their body, slightly raising their Accuracy and drastically raising their Speed.

SANDSTORM.Name: Sandstorm
SANDSTORM.Description: Whips up a sandstorm that hurts all but Rock-, Ground-, and Steel-types for 8 turns.

STEALTHROCK.Name: Stealth Rock
STEALTHROCK.Description: The user lays a trap that deals Rock-type damage to opponents that switch into battle.

WIDEGUARD.Name: Wide Guard
WIDEGUARD.Description: Erects a protective force which halves damage from spread attacks for 5 turns.

DOOMDESIRE.Name: Doom Desire
DOOMDESIRE.Description: 3 turns after this move is used, the active opponent is blasted with nuclear force.

IRONTAIL.Name: Iron Tail
IRONTAIL.Description: The target is smashed with a hardened tail. Has a 30% chance to raise the user's Defense.

METEORMASH.Name: Meteor Mash
METEORMASH.Description: The target is hit with a hard punch fired like a meteor. Has a 20% chance to raise the user's Attack.

LIGHTARTILLERY.Name: Light Artillery
LIGHTARTILLERY.Description: This long shot procs Powder Keg/Garden Variety. 50% chance to lower the target's Accuracy.

IRONHEAD.Name: Iron Head
IRONHEAD.Description: Slams the target with their metal head. Has a 20% flinch chance.

STEELWING.Name: Steel Wing
STEELWING.Description: The target is struck with wings that have a 70% chance to lower their Defense.

MIRRORSHOT.Name: Mirror Shot
MIRRORSHOT.Description: This trick shot deals x2 damage if a screen like Reflect or Safeguard is active for either team.

OVERCLOCK.Name: Overclock
OVERCLOCK.Description: This exhausting attack restores the user's HP and status, but puts them to sleep for 2 turns.

GEARGRIND.Name: Gear Grind
GEARGRIND.Description: Attacks with body or jaws by grinding the target's gears. Twice. Each hit has a 15% torment chance.

METALCLAW.Name: Metal Claw
METALCLAW.Description: The target is raked with steel claws that also raise the user's Attack.

ROCKETFIST.Name: Rocket Fist
ROCKETFIST.Description: The user fires their fist with jet propulsion. Strikes with priority. Has 1/4 Recoil Damage.

GYROBALL.Name: Gyro Ball
GYROBALL.Description: This high-torque whirl's power increases based on the difference between the user's and target's Speed.

HEAVYSLAM.Name: Heavy Slam
HEAVYSLAM.Description: The user slams with their heavy body. The heavier the user is than the target, the greater the power.

METALBURST.Name: Metal Burst
METALBURST.Description: If the user goes second, they inflict x1.5 dmg taken from their last attack. Builds Momentum.

AUTOTOMIZE.Name: Autotomize
AUTOTOMIZE.Description: The user mechanizes their body, streamlining it. This cuts 1/4th Max HP but maximizes Speed.

IRONDOME.Name: Iron Dome
IRONDOME.Description: Maxes Defense, Sp. Defense, and doubles weight with priority, but the stats drop sharply every turn.

METALSOUND.Name: Metal Sound
METALSOUND.Description: A horrible sound like scraping metal drastically lowers all targets' Sp. Def.

SHIFTGEAR.Name: Shift Gear
SHIFTGEAR.Description: The user rotates their gears, raising their Attack, Defense, and Speed.

SALVAGE.Name: Salvage
SALVAGE.Description: Steals 2 Def from the target with priority. Next turn, the user deals x2 dmg with non-contact moves.

CAVALCADE.Name: Cavalcade
CAVALCADE.Description: Utterly deluges the target. Ignores abilities; transfers negative stat changes to the target.

HYDROPUMP.Name: Hydro Pump
HYDROPUMP.Description: This pressurized deluge creates 2 procs of Aqua Ring if the user switches out next turn.

LURCHINGMURK.Name: Lurching Murk
LURCHINGMURK.Description: Swamps enemies, gaining bonus damage and effects based on hazards on your own field.

TIDALWAVE.Name: Tidal Wave
TIDALWAVE.Description: Crushes enemies under a giant wave, dealing double damage to any that have been on the field over 5 turns.

SWELLBREAKER.Name: Swellbreaker
SWELLBREAKER.Description: Crashes down on all opponents like a tsunami. Requires a recharge turn unless it KO's.

CRABHAMMER.Name: Crabhammer
CRABHAMMER.Description: The target is hammered with a large pincer. High Crit ratio.

DEPTHCHARGE.Name: Depth Charge
DEPTHCHARGE.Description: Dives the first turn, then attacks. Plants 2 charges dealing 1/10th dmg to enemies switching in.

SCALD.Name: Scald
SCALD.Description: The user flings boiling water at the target. Has a 30% Burn chance.

TORPEDO.Name: Torpedo
TORPEDO.Description: The user jets toward the target like a missile, always raising their own Sp. Atk.

RAZORSHELL.Name: Razor Shell
RAZORSHELL.Description: The sharp shelled attack has +10 power for each of the target's stat changes.

BRINE.Name: Brine
BRINE.Description: This stinging water blast deals double damage against targets at or below half HP.

BUBBLEBEAM.Name: Bubble Beam
BUBBLEBEAM.Description: A jet of bubbles fatigues the targets, cutting their last-used move's PP by 4.

OCTAZOOKA.Name: Octazooka
OCTAZOOKA.Description: The user attacks with a forceful, inky pulse. 50% chance to lower the target's Accuracy.

SONARPULSE.Name: Sonar Pulse
SONARPULSE.Description: Pings with subsonic sound. 30% Confusion chance. High Crit ratio. x1.5 dmg if Paragon move.

ZONECONTROL.Name: Zone Control
ZONECONTROL.Description: Zones out all targets. Enemies using a switch-out move lose 1/3 Max HP. Stacks 8x.

AQUAJET.Name: Aqua Jet
AQUAJET.Description: Bursts forward with priority, but this slightly lowers the user's Defense and Sp. Def.

WATERGUN.Name: Water Gun
WATERGUN.Description: These forceful shots of water inflicts bonus damage equal to half the user's level.

CLAMP.Name: Clamp
CLAMP.Description: Clamps down with a sharp shell or jaws. Power doubles if used on a target switching out of battle.

WHIRLPOOL.Name: Whirlpool
WHIRLPOOL.Description: Traps the target in a dangerous whirlpool for 3 turns, dealing 1/6th Max HP each turn.

BUBBLE.Name: Bubble
BUBBLE.Description: The user raises Sp. Def with priority. Also doubles the power of its Water-type moves next turn.

AQUARING.Name: Aqua Ring
AQUARING.Description: Creates a veil of water healing active teammates by 1/8th Max HP each turn. Fades after 5 procs.

RAINDANCE.Name: Rain Dance
RAINDANCE.Description: Summons rain for 8 turns, powering up Water-type moves and weakening Fire-type moves.

SOAK.Name: Soak
SOAK.Description: The user soaks the targets, lowering their Sp. Atk and changing their type to Water.

BLEAKWINTER.Name: Bleak Winter
BLEAKWINTER.Description: The user dampens enemies with bitter ice. Always lowers the targets' Sp. Defense.

WITHDRAW.Name: Withdraw
WITHDRAW.Description: The user withdraws their into their shell, raising their Defense and Sp. Atk.

AROMATICMIST.Name: Aromatic Mist
AROMATICMIST.Description: The user drastically raises the Speed stat of an ally Pokémon using a mysterious aroma.

SPELLBIND.Name: Spellbind
SPELLBIND.Description: Binds the target's thoughts with a seemingly magical ritual. Always Enchants the target.

UPHEAVE.Name: Upheave
UPHEAVE.Description: Pukes violently all over the target. Fails unless the user's eaten a Berry, Herb, or Terrain Seed.

HOTSTREAK.Name: Hot Streak
HOTSTREAK.Description: Riding its hot hand, this move has +35 power for each consecutive momentum move used.

SCYTHE.Name: Guardian Scythe
SCYTHE.Description: Cleaves the target with a blade, cutting their HP in half or KO'ing if below 1/2 Max HP.

GLAZE.Name: Guardian Glaze
GLAZE.Description: Freezer burns the target, eliminating positive stat changes and stopping stat increases for 5 turns.

DAZZLINGGLEAM.Name: Dazzling Gleam
DAZZLINGGLEAM.Description: The user bathes everything around in shimmering light energy. 30% chance to Enchant.

DISARMINGVOICE.Name: Disarming Voice
DISARMINGVOICE.Description: A heartbreaking cry that does emotional damage to opposing Pokémon, lowering their Sp. Atk.

DRAININGKISS.Name: Draining Kiss
DRAININGKISS.Description: The user steals HP with a kiss. Restores HP equal to 75% damage dealt.

CONVULSIONS.Name: Guardian Convulsions
CONVULSIONS.Description: Seizes up the target into using their last used move for 3 turns.

EERIEIMPULSE.Name: Eerie Impulse
EERIEIMPULSE.Description: The user's body generates a widespread pulse that lowers Crit ratio by 4 stages.

POWERMORPH.Name: Power Morph
POWERMORPH.Description: The user contours the field into High-Powered Terrain for 8 turns.

VERDANTMORPH.Name: Verdant Morph
VERDANTMORPH.Description: The user contours the field into Verdant Terrain for 8 turns.

MISTYMORPH.Name: Misty Morph
MISTYMORPH.Description: The user contours the field into Misty Terrain for 8 turns.

FAIRYWIND.Name: Fairy Wind
FAIRYWIND.Description: Fae wind triggers a Phazard, such as Vine Snare, on the opponent's field. Never misses.

FELLSTINGER.Name: Fell Stinger
FELLSTINGER.Description: A nasty, piercing strike that drastically raises the user's Attack if it KO's a target.

RUTHLESSMORPH.Name: Ruthless Morph
RUTHLESSMORPH.Description: The user contours the field into Ruthless Terrain for 8 turns.

QUARANTINE.Name: Quarantine
QUARANTINE.Description: Cuts 1/2 Max HP to prevent the target from switching for 3 turns no matter what.

BLACKMOLD.Name: Black Mold
BLACKMOLD.Description: Decomposes active opponents, dealing 1/8th Max HP damage to them each turn. Fades after 5 procs.

FREEZEDRY.Name: Freeze-Dry
FREEZEDRY.Description: Rapidly cools the target. Has a 10% Freeze chance and is super effective against Water-types.

GEOMANCY.Name: Geomancy
GEOMANCY.Description: Heals 1/2 of its team's missing HP, cures their status, restores 1/2 Max HP, and shores up with priority. Requires a recharge turn.

MUNDANEMORPH.Name: Mundane Morph
MUNDANEMORPH.Description: The user contours the field into Mundane Terrain for 8 turns.

INFESTATION.Name: Infestation
INFESTATION.Description: Traps and infests the target for 3 turns, dealing 1/6th Max HP damage each turn.

ELECTRICFENCE.Name: Electric Fence
