IMPALE.Name: Impale
IMPALE.Description: Pierces and drains the target. Heals for half dmg dealt and slightly lowers their Defense.

RISINGMERCURY.Name: Rising Mercury
RISINGMERCURY.Description: The user jabs twice with liquid metal. Each hit has a 30% chance to Poison the target.

SWEETTOOTH.Name: Sweet Tooth
SWEETTOOTH.Description: This lingering sweetness makes residual healing effects restore 1/16th more HP for 5 turns.

BRAINSTORM.Name: Brain Storm
BRAINSTORM.Description: Gathers ideas the first turn, then unloads a meaty flurry of brains. Executes in one turn in Hail or Sand.

ABSOLUTETRUTH.Name: Absolute Truth
ABSOLUTETRUTH.Description: This omnipotent move strikes with priority, deals 150 damage, and weakens all stats of all opponents.

POWERCHORD.Name: Power Chord
POWERCHORD.Description: Plays a killer or gutwrenching solo for the audience. This move's type depends on the user's.

OVERDOSE.Name: Overdose
OVERDOSE.Description: Drugs the target to Sleep for 2 turns while raising their Attack, Sp. Atk, and Speed.

TEAPARTY.Name: Tea Party
TEAPARTY.Description: Throws a ghostly tea party that flips all targets' positive stat changes negative.

CAUSTICCORE.Name: Caustic Core
CAUSTICCORE.Description: A 3-part spitting attack. Each hit has a 10% Confusion chance and is 15 BP stronger than the last.

PILLARSOFLAW.Name: Pillars of Law
PILLARSOFLAW.Description: With priority, inverts the type chart for 5 turns, then collapses on non Rock-types for 1/4th Max HP dmg.

WALLOP.Name: Guardian Wallop
WALLOP.Description: Damage is based on the user's Speed stat. Inflicts grievous wounds for 5 turns.

REMODEL.Name: Guardian Remodel
REMODEL.Description: The user is protected from damage, curing status, Compromising effects, and healing for 1/4 Max HP.

BACKSTAB.Name: Backstab
BACKSTAB.Description: Its first use each battle has x2 base dmg, scaling with the target's weight. Uses their lower base defending stat.

GRAVITONCORE.Name: Graviton Core
GRAVITONCORE.Description: Creates a singularity which prevents the opposing team from using their held items for 8 turns.

LOCKJAW.Name: Lock Jaw
LOCKJAW.Description: An unrelenting biting move that prevents the target from switching out.

CRUSHINGBLOW.Name: Crushing Blow
CRUSHINGBLOW.Description: Deals more dmg based on heaviness. Deals 1/8th HP dmg if the user has stat boosts and no reductions.

BANALAFFAIR.Name: Banal Affair
BANALAFFAIR.Description: The user is unimpressed. Damage is based on the user's highest stat. Never misses.

SCALETIPPER.Name: Scale Tipper
SCALETIPPER.Description: Tips over the target with a scaly limb or tail, making their positive stat changes negative.

DECORATE.Name: Decorate
DECORATE.Description: Slightly raises the ally's Attack, Defense, Sp. Atk, Sp. Def, and Speed by decorating them.

CIRCADIANRHYTHM.Name: Circadian Rhythm
CIRCADIANRHYTHM.Description: The user's beat echoes through the ground, doubling the Atk of active allies for 4 turns.

ETERNABEAM.Name: Eternabeam
ETERNABEAM.Description: Unless the target is at 1 HP, this infinite beam leaves 1 HP instead of KO'ing

LIFEDEW.Name: Life Dew
LIFEDEW.Description: Sprinkles living water, healing 1/3rd of its and an active partner's Max HP. Heals 1/2 in Sand.

COMETSPEAR.Name: Comet Spear
COMETSPEAR.Description: A skewering strike with devastating impact. High Crit ratio, but requires a recharge turn.

ENFORCEMENT.Name: Enforcement
ENFORCEMENT.Description: The user is protected from damage and Confuses attackers using attacking moves.

WINDSOFCHANGE.Name: Winds of Change
WINDSOFCHANGE.Description: A strange, powerful wind that changes the user's type to match the target's.

FORBIDDENFRUIT.Name: Forbidden Fruit
FORBIDDENFRUIT.Description: The user consumes their own item to curse the target and lay a Creeping Doubt Phazard.

BODYPRESS.Name: Body Press
BODYPRESS.Description: The user crushes the target with their body. Damage is based on the user's Defense stat.

BUZZERBEATER.Name: Buzzer Beater
BUZZERBEATER.Description: Kicks a wicked, arcing shot. Drastically raises the user's Attack if it KO's a target.

SNIPESHOT.Name: Snipe Shot
SNIPESHOT.Description: The user fires a pin-point shot at the target's weak spot, always resulting in a Critical hit.

BRAINFREEZE.Name: Brain Freeze
BRAINFREEZE.Description: Turns the target's power against it. The higher the target's Sp. Atk stat, the greater the damage.

UNSTABLEMATTER.Name: Unstable Matter
UNSTABLEMATTER.Description: A devastating cytokinetic attack. Moves last. The user flinches if hit first.

STRANGESTEAM.Name: Strange Steam
STRANGESTEAM.Description: Unless the target is at 1 HP, this misty attack leaves 1 HP instead of KO'ing.

STUFFCHEEKS.Name: Stuff Cheeks
STUFFCHEEKS.Description: The user eats its held Berry to raise its Defense, Sp. Defense, and heal 1/4th Max HP.

TENTACLYSM.Name: Guardian Tentaclysm
TENTACLYSM.Description: Jagged tentacles remove the target's item, knock them away, and drag out a different Pokémon.

OBELISK.Name: Guardian Obelisk
OBELISK.Description: Discovers a Treasure; also lowers the Speed of the opposing team for 8 turns.

SPECIALSNOWFLAKE.Name: Special Snowflake
SPECIALSNOWFLAKE.Description: Immunes your team to crits and residual damage for 8 turns if the user has 3 moves or less.

REQUIEM.Name: Requiem
REQUIEM.Description: Damages all enemies in the target's party for 1/12th current HP if the user has 3 moves or less.

RISINGTIDE.Name: Rising Tide
RISINGTIDE.Description: Every third turn the user is active, this inevitable attack deals double damage.

GLACIALMARCH.Name: Glacial March
GLACIALMARCH.Description: Every third turn the user is active, this inevitable attack deals double damage.

FOODFIGHT.Name: Food Fight
FOODFIGHT.Description: Better duck! 50% chance to scatter a random entry hazard on both players' fields.

CENTRIFUGE.Name: Centrifuge
CENTRIFUGE.Description: Spins a concoction that bounces back an enemy attack's secondary effect. Stacks 8x.

TRIALBYFIRE.Name: Trial by Fire
TRIALBYFIRE.Description: This cauterizing gauntlet raises the target's Critical Hit Ratio.

FERROMANCY.Name: Ferromancy
FERROMANCY.Description: This magnetizing attack manipulates fields around the target, damaging them but raising their Speed.

TWISTEDTWILIGHT.Name: Twisted Twilight
TWISTEDTWILIGHT.Description: A corkscrewing, interweaving attack that slightly raises the target's Attack and Sp. Atk.

WITSPLITTER.Name: Witsplitter
WITSPLITTER.Description: This breaking point attack has +10 power for each of the target's stat changes. Strikes with priority.

CARBONCOPY.Name: Carbon Copy
CARBONCOPY.Description: Highly carbonated. Copies all debuff-only moves' effects your team has used with half effectiveness.

HIVEMIND.Name: Hive Mind
HIVEMIND.Description: We are legion. Copies all debuff-only moves' effects your team has used with half effectiveness.

KINDREDSPIRITS.Name: Kindred Spirits
KINDREDSPIRITS.Description: Summons guardian spirits to attack. Has +5 power per ally switched out this battle.

GLOBALCOOLING.Name: Global Cooling
GLOBALCOOLING.Description: Its body physically cools everything around. Has +5 power per ally switched out this battle.

ASPHYXIATE.Name: Asphyxiate
ASPHYXIATE.Description: Stifles the air, dealing 1/8th Max HP damage to active opponents each turn. Fades after 5 procs.

ELDERBLOOD.Name: Elder Blood
ELDERBLOOD.Description: Immunes attacks from all opponents' primary typing for 3 turns, but Poisons your next switch-in.

AFTERGLOW.Name: Afterglow
AFTERGLOW.Description: Statusing or flinching targets torments them; gives your team an embers phazard. Fades after 5 procs.

EYEOFTHESTORM.Name: Eye of the Storm
EYEOFTHESTORM.Description: Creates a field that reduces stat boosts by 1 and doubles created phazards for 8 turns.

PROMISEDLAND.Name: Promised Land
PROMISEDLAND.Description: Sharply raises the next suboptimally natured ally's lower offensive and defensive stats. Stacks 8x.

HIDDENDRAGON.Name: Hidden Dragon
HIDDENDRAGON.Description: Hits first and flinches the target, but can only be used once while the user is in battle.

ANCESTRALASPECT.Name: Ancestral Aspect
ANCESTRALASPECT.Description: This Dragon Aspect empowers your team's next two attacks with Parental Bond. Stacks 8x.

DAILYGRIND.Name: Daily Grind
DAILYGRIND.Description: This humdrum attack compels the target to keep using its last-used move for 3 turns, except in doubles.

FORGOTTENARTS.Name: Forgotten Arts
FORGOTTENARTS.Description: The user channels high sorcery, always raising their own Def and Sp. Def.

FATALFLOURISH.Name: Fatal Flourish
FATALFLOURISH.Description: This stylish attack deals x2 damage if the user has stat boosts and no stat reductions.

RIPPLINGICHOR.Name: Rippling Ichor
RIPPLINGICHOR.Description: Gushes ichor that causes an enemy's next non-STAB super effective attack to deal x0.66 damage. Stacks 8x.

BROODCOCOON.Name: Brood Cocoon
BROODCOCOON.Description: Shoots a disgusting cocoon that has a 30% chance to Poison, Confuse, or Trap the target.

FOUNTAINOFYOUTH.Name: Fountain of Youth
FOUNTAINOFYOUTH.Description: This magical font heals allies switching into battle based on their resistance to Water.

TERRANOVA.Name: Terra Nova
TERRANOVA.Description: A full-spectrum attack that hits all enemies and gains bonus effects based on the active Terrain.

SILENTBLISS.Name: Silent Bliss
SILENTBLISS.Description: Quiet. The user heals equal to half their level, then disables sound-based moves for 3 turns.

CORNUCOPIA.Name: Cornucopia
CORNUCOPIA.Description: Gains +40 dmg per: screens are up; every 3rd turn; user Compromised; user under 1/2 HP.

SHELLSHOCK.Name: Shell Shock
SHELLSHOCK.Description: This electrical backlash's power increases with the difference between the user's and target's Sp. Atk.

SILVERBULLET.Name: Silver Bullet
SILVERBULLET.Description: This precise shot's power increases with the difference between the user's and target's Atk.

PROMETHEANCHAIN.Name: Promethean Chain
PROMETHEANCHAIN.Description: It may not steal fire from the gods, but it does steal 2 Attack from the target and their item.

NEVERLAND.Name: Neverland
NEVERLAND.Description: 20% chance to lull the target into a 2 turn Sleep after their next turn. Never misses in Terrain.

QUANTUMLEAP.Name: Quantum Leap
QUANTUMLEAP.Description: This time-bending attack extends the duration of side-wide effects like Hellfire or screens by 2 turns.

SPOILEDROTTEN.Name: Spoiled Rotten
SPOILEDROTTEN.Description: The user rots the target with their filthy pride, always raising their own Sp. Atk.

HIDDENGEM.Name: Hidden Gem
HIDDENGEM.Description: The user unearths rare minerals to raise the Attack, Sp. Atk, and Acc of an ally.

GLASSCANNON.Name: Glass Cannon
GLASSCANNON.Description: Blasts the target with deadly shards, but it slightly lowers the user's Defense and Sp. Def.

SNOWDRIFT.Name: Snow Drift
SNOWDRIFT.Description: The user lowers the target's Attack by sledding them into a pile of snow.

DOWNTIME.Name: Guardian Downtime
DOWNTIME.Description: Disables the opposing team's items and reduces their Attack, Sp. Atk, and Speed x0.75 for 8 turns.

RETROSPECT.Name: Guardian Retrospect
RETROSPECT.Description: Fills the target with bad memories, casting a Haze, Creeping Doubt, and Requiem.

FATHOMBREACH.Name: Guardian Fathombreach
FATHOMBREACH.Description: The user bores inevitably downwards. Lays 2 stakes, but has 1/3 Recoil Damage.

SEARSCREW.Name: Guardian Searscrew
SEARSCREW.Description: The user burns the target, lowers their Defense, and sets Hellfire for 5 turns.

MARROWBURST.Name: Guardian Marrowburst
MARROWBURST.Description: Freezes the target. Or, if already frozen, heals equal to the target's missing HP, then KO's them.

SQUALL.Name: Guardian Squall
SQUALL.Description: Changes the targets' type to Flying. Protects allies from Enchantment, stat loss for 8 turns.

DIRESTRAITS.Name: Dire Straits
DIRESTRAITS.Description: Crushes the target under panic-inducing water. 50% chance to sharply lower the target's Def.

POWDERKEG.Name: Powder Keg
POWDERKEG.Description: Gives your team's next ball/bomb, pulse, recharge, breath and two-turn move x1.5 dmg. Stacks 8x.

POLARVORTEX.Name: Polar Vortex
POLARVORTEX.Description: This howling gale switches out the target for a random ally. The user flinches if hit first.

TRANSCISION.Name: Transcision
TRANSCISION.Description: Scalpels and mixes fluids with the target. Each first use, swaps items with the target.

TREACHEREEDS.Name: Treachereeds
TREACHEREEDS.Description: If itemless, this cunning bushcraft attack makes the user a substitute using 1/4 Max HP.

PESTER.Name: Pester
PESTER.Description: Disables enemies' Paragon Moves, Torments them, and cuts 1 PP from their moves for 8 turns.

BEASTWITHIN.Name: Beast Within
BEASTWITHIN.Description: Uses the target's lower base defending stat. Can't be used in conjunction with allies' Special attacks.

GROUNDZERO.Name: Ground Zero
GROUNDZERO.Description: Uses the target's lower base defending stat. Can't be used in conjunction with allies' Physical attacks.

UNCANNYVALLEY.Name: Uncanny Valley
UNCANNYVALLEY.Description: Something feels off... Transforms the target into a copy of the user, except for HP.

SLIPPERYSLOPE.Name: Slippery Slope
SLIPPERYSLOPE.Description: Boosting moves raise allies' Speed. Can't be used in conjunction with moves over 80 power.

WEEPINGABSCESS.Name: Weeping Abscess
WEEPINGABSCESS.Description: This uncontrolled, malignant attack has a 20% chance to raise the user's Sp. Attack.

CEASELESSMALICE.Name: Ceaseless Malice
CEASELESSMALICE.Description: Commences a horror movie-esque assault for 3 turns, then becomes Paralyzed.

ELECTRICCHAIR.Name: Electric Chair
ELECTRICCHAIR.Description: This deadly current uses the higher attacking stat, but cuts 3 PP from allies' moves for 2 turns.

SPREADINGPLAGUE.Name: Spreading Plague
SPREADINGPLAGUE.Description: Spreads a deadly airborne plague onto enemies. 30% chance to leave Compound Gas.

PYRRHICVICTORY.Name: Pyrrhic Victory
PYRRHICVICTORY.Description: For 5 procs each, residual damage and healing effects, except weather, have 1/16th more effectiveness.

POISONEDPAWN.Name: Poisoned Pawn
POISONEDPAWN.Description: Makes a substitute using 1/4 Max HP which prevents the user from being damaged or statused until broken.

WINDBREAKER.Name: Guardian Windbreaker
WINDBREAKER.Description: Sets the target's Critical Hit Ratio to -4, then heals 1/8 Max HP per Crit stage lowered by this effect.

SKYSPLITTER.Name: Guardian Skysplitter
SKYSPLITTER.Description: Leaves a Lightning Chain and has +20 power for each of the target's stat changes.

MUTATION.Name: Guardian Mutation
MUTATION.Description: Deals 1/4th Max HP dmg to active opponents each turn, for 3 procs. Also creates 3 Compound Gas procs.

INVASION.Name: Guardian Invasion
INVASION.Description: Restores HP equal to 75% damage dealt. Deals x2 damage to Compromised targets. Requires a recharge turn.

BOTTLEDLIGHTNING.Name: Bottled Lightning
BOTTLEDLIGHTNING.Description: The user catches lightning, doubling the Sp. Atk of active allies for 4 turns.

COMPACTOR.Name: Compactor
COMPACTOR.Description: A churning, crushing attack that also eliminates entry hazards and effects like Bind or Leech Seed.

EUREKA.Name: Eureka!
EUREKA.Description: This brilliant attack consumes the user's item to erect 5 turns of Industrial Grade.

CHARITY.Name: Guardian Charity
CHARITY.Description: Cures any status or Compromising effects, casts Lucky Chant, and Cotton Spore.

HORTICULTURE.Name: Guardian Horticulture
HORTICULTURE.Description: Traps the target. Triggers a Phazard, such as Vine Snare, on the opponent's field. High Crit ratio. Never misses.

SPLICE.Name: Guardian Splice
SPLICE.Description: Replaces this move with the target's move, reduces the target's move's PP to 0, then heals based on the PP lost.

STRAND.Name: Guardian Strand
STRAND.Description: Casts a Rocky Payload, then cuts 4 PP from opponents' moves and slightly lowers their Accuracy each turn for 8 turns.

ASCENSION.Name: Guardian Ascension
ASCENSION.Description: Increases Attack, Def, Sp. Atk, Sp. Def, and Speed 1 stage for each opposing fainted Pokemon.
